about.en: Metadium is a South Korean public blockchain for self-sovereign decentralized identity (DID), developed by Coinplug. META is the native coin of the Metadium mainnet; it originated as the ERC-20 at 0xdE2F7766C8BF14CA67193128535E5c7454f8387C on Ethereum. It is unrelated to MetaDAO, Meta Platforms and other META tickers.
